target_customer: Corporations and governments buying carbon dioxide removal, plus industrial emitters wanting point source capture
problem: Direct air capture is energy hungry and expensive, which blocks scaling of carbon removal.
business_model: Carbon removal sold per tonne and capture systems for emitters; revenue not yet reported
product_category: Direct air capture hardware using a regenerable liquid sorbent

founders.name: Mark Cyffka
founders.background_notes: Product manager at Chemetall-BASF and R&D engineer at Honeywell per YC page.

founders.name: Sudip Mukhopadhyay
founders.background_notes: Helped develop refrigerant 1234yf and was a founding member of Honeywell drone and air taxi startups per YC page.

competitors.name: Climeworks
competitors.what: Solid sorbent direct air capture plants

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a low energy capture system with a regenerable liquid sorbent and low temperature heat is hardware and chemistry research at scale for a team of two founders.

defensibility.rationale: Sorbent and process IP could matter, but well funded rivals (Climeworks, Heirloom) were far ahead and no patents were verified in sources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied or bought AirMyne in sources found; the field kept attracting new entrants.

market_need_then: Corporate carbon removal purchase commitments and US policy support rose around 2022, and funding for direct air capture companies was large that year, per the competitor coverage.

branding.domain_note: Uses airmyne.com. US trademark AIRMYNE filed 2022-01-26, pending, per trademark listings.

identity.voice_and_tone: Engineering and mission language about managing CO2 already in the air

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage by Carbon Herald exists but concerns the technology, not the brand; no community or merch found.

outcome_analysis: AirMyne launched in 2022 from YC with a liquid sorbent approach that uses low temperature heat, raised a reported 6.9M seed in March 2024, and has since moved toward a commercial pilot. It is capital intensive hardware in a field dominated by far better funded rivals, so milestones depend on follow on funding; no exit or distress was found.
notes: Seed 6.9M in 2024-03 is reported by Carbon Herald and Carbon Pulse snippets and CB Insights; exact day varies (03-01, 03-20, 03-21). Totals conflict: 6.9M, 7.03M, 11.03M over 4 rounds; earlier rounds not itemized so coverage is partial. A strategic round with ENEOS in 2026-03 appears only in Yespress and Caplight snippets and is not recorded. YC page says founded 2022; trademark filed January 2022. A squarespace page claims the founders met at Honeywell in 2012; unverified. Sudip education not listed.
